note: Reported class (engine vocabulary): STOP container 120, then USE its exec/console afterwards — cannot work while stopped. Contradiction HIT; single context so multi-action NONE.
text:
## Fix

1. Stop the container:
```bash
pct stop 120
```
Wait a few seconds for it to shut down.

2. Now open its console to rebuild the config:
```bash
pct exec 120 -- nano /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
```
Save and exit when done.
